sn47.95-104:1.1: cattāro me bhikkhave oghā. katame cattāro: kāmogho, bhavogho, diṭṭhogho, avijjogho. ime kho bhikkhave, cattāro oghā. imesaṃ kho bhikkhave, catunnaṃ oghānaṃ abhiññāya cattāro satipaṭṭhānā bhāvetabbā. katame cattāro: -pe- bhāvetabboti. 3. 10. 160. uddhambhāgiyasuttaṃ pañcimāni bhikkhave, uddhambhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni.
sn47.95-104:1.5: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave, pañcannaṃ uddhambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ pahānāya cattāro satipaṭṭhānā bhāvetabbā.
sn47.95-104:2.2: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.95-104:2.5: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.95-104:2.6: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave, pañcannaṃ uddhambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ pahānāya ime cattāro satipaṭṭhānā bhāvetabbāti.
sn47.95-104:4.4: khandhā oruddhambhāgiyāti. (atrā’pi yathā esanāvaggo ekasatasaṭṭhi suttantā vitthāretabbā.)
sn47.95-104:4.5: satipaṭṭhānasaṃyuttaṃ samattaṃ. tatra vagguddānaṃ: ambapāli ca nālando sīlaṭṭhityānanussutā amato gaṅgāppamādā balakaraṇīyesanoghāti.
